cues: The three service models differ in how much of the stack you still manage.
On your own premises, you manage everything, down to the network cables.
Infrastructure as a service rents you virtual machines: you still install the operating system and software.
Platform as a service gives a ready platform: you bring only your application and data.
Software as a service, like Gmail, gives finished software: you manage nothing but your own data.
